result.summary: This PR adds a check so that RPC/tool wallet creation rejects names consisting solely of whitespace, by trimming the name (without mutating stored value) before the existing empty-name check. It touches CreateWallet, CreateFromDump, and the wallettool create path, and adds functional test coverage for the new rejection. After maintainer pushback, the author restored the ability to load pre-existing whitespace-named wallets (RestoreWallet unaffected) to avoid breaking backward compatibility.
result.problem: Currently a user can create a wallet whose name is only spaces (e.g. via bitcoin-cli createwallet "    "), producing directories that look empty or indistinguishable from each other, which is confusing when browsing the wallets directory. This mostly affects a hypothetical/rare user who accidentally or intentionally creates such a wallet; no concrete complaint or issue is cited.

open_concerns: maflcko questions whether there is any real benefit and calls the change risky for pre-existing whitespace-padded names, with 'seems highly risky... so ~0 for a risky change without any benefits.'

polespinasa proposes expanding scope to also reject leading/trailing whitespace (not just whitespace-only names), require an error message change, add release notes, and add more tests, which the author agreed to implement but has not yet pushed.
maflcko additionally raises a code conflict with PR #35833 and probes for the 'real motivation' behind the whitespace-only restriction, without a clear resolution.
resolved_concerns: achow101's concern about breaking backward compatibility for existing whitespace-only-named wallets during load/restore was addressed by the author restoring the RestoreWallet path to still allow loading such wallets.

result.card: This PR makes wallet creation (and the wallettool create path) reject names consisting solely of whitespace, by checking the trimmed name against emptiness without mutating the stored name, while keeping backward-compatible loading of pre-existing whitespace-only-named wallets after achow101's feedback. The problem is cosmetic: a whitespace-only wallet name produces directories that look empty or indistinguishable, but no issue or user report is cited and maintainer maflcko called the benefit near-zero given the risk of touching name handling. Maintainer polespinasa instead proposed a broader restriction on leading/trailing whitespace with release notes and more tests, and the author has agreed to rework the PR accordingly but has not yet pushed that revision, so review of the current diff is likely to be invalidated soon. There is also a noted code conflict with open PR #35833 (log injection prevention). Agreement is Disputed: one maintainer objects to the benefit-risk tradeoff, another is engaged but pushing for a different, larger scope, and no consensus direction has been finalized.
